verdict.rationale: Radar lets users define custom rules on supported attributes that run automatically on payment events. Documented actions include requesting 3DS, blocking payments by location or card origin, auto-allowing trusted customers, and automatically pausing payouts on high-dispute accounts. Community reports note a lack of easy programmatic control and that Allow rules need support to enable for newer businesses; these are limitations, not contradictions. missing for 10: actions limited to fraud and payment outcomes (block/allow/review/3DS/pause), no evidence of programmatic or API-based rule authoring, Allow rules gated behind support, no hands-on corroboration of rule execution.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: you can also set up rules that are unique to your business using the supported attributes
